references.text: Parallel text describing the making of the breastpiece with the same four rows of precious stones, including ruby, topaz, and emerald in the first row.
Ezekiel's description of the king of Tyre's splendor includes several of the same precious stones found on the breastpiece, among them ruby and topaz.
Revelation describes the foundations of the new Jerusalem adorned with precious stones, which include several of the same stones as the breastpiece, such as jasper, sapphire, and emerald.
Mentions precious stones to be gathered for the ephod and the breastpiece, including onyx stones and setting stones.
Repeats the list of materials to be gathered, including precious stones for the ephod and the breastpiece.
This is the direct continuation of the list of stones on the breastplate that began in the source verse.
